errorMap.notes: Billing 429s: read error.code, since error.type can still be insufficient_quota. A 403 is keyed on its code: unsupported_country_region_territory is a region block, misalignment_policy_violation a content block. The code strings invalid_api_key, model_not_found and unsupported_country_region_territory are unconfirmed on an OpenAI page; the status fallback covers them.

privacy.retention: Abuse logs up to 30 days; Responses stored 30 days unless store:false
privacy.trains: No, unless your organization opts in to sharing (the app can't see that switch)
privacy.sets: store:false always; a random per-install safety_identifier on every request
privacy.notes: A random per-install safety_identifier is sent so OpenAI can act per install rather than per key.

player.short: Keeps abuse logs up to 30 days; no training by default.
player.trains: No, unless your OpenAI organization turned on data sharing. You can check that in your OpenAI account.
player.sets: Asks OpenAI to keep nothing beyond its abuse logs, and sends a random ID for this install.

terms.login: API key only (DB6). No ChatGPT-plan login.
notes: A high-confidence violation can block this install's safety_identifier for good.
Region errors never suggest a VPN: access from unsupported regions may lead to blocking.
playerNotes: Use a normal API key. Admin keys can’t be used here.
